fact: UNICEF's evaluation, carried out between January and April 2019, found that births are notified at health facilities in printed birth notification booklets (registers), and that electronic data entry piloted in seven health facilities (five in Northern Bahr el Ghazal, with Juba Teaching Hospital and Munuki PHCC) had not been successful in the majority of them, the server and database being housed at UNICEF rather than the Ministry of Interior.
title: Final Report for Multi-Country Evaluation for Birth Registration for Maternal, Newborn, Child Health (BR4MNCH) Project in Ethiopia and South Sudan
publisher: UNICEF East and Southern Africa Regional Office
